subject: Quick qual + demo slot for receipts extraction (self-serve signup)
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fastretail.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: receipts extraction / pilot timeline

Hi Priyom,

Signed up through the self-serve flow earlier today — thanks for making the sign-up smooth. We're looking to evaluate Redwood for an automated receipts and expense ingestion flow. High level: we ingest point-of-sale receipts from our merchants and want line-item extraction + normalized merchant metadata.

Quick context to help triage:
- Expected monthly volume: ~500k - 2M receipts initially (depends on pilot conversion).
- Average receipt size: ~350-600 tokens (many long itemized receipts).
- Peak concurrency: maybe 5-10 simultaneous extraction jobs.
- Timeline: pilot ideally starting mid-August, production by Q4 if pilot goes well.

Would love to book a short demo (30 min) this week or early next to see integrations and SLA/cost tradeoffs. I've attached a small sample traffic CSV with anonymized rows.

Thanks —
Alex Turner
Director, Data Engineering
FastRetail
attachments: fastretail_sample_traffic.csv (CSV)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fastretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: receipts extraction / pilot timeline

Alex — thanks for the context and for signing up. I'm Priyom on the SDR team; looping in Ben (AE) to join the call so we can cover pricing and pilot options. A few quick clarifying questions so we come prepared:

- Is the 500k–2M monthly count receipts (i.e., 1 API call per receipt) or documents bundled (e.g., batches of receipts per request)?
- Do you need embedding vectors (search/index) in addition to the extraction APIs, or purely structured extraction + entity normalization?
- Any latency SLOs for the extraction path (e.g., P95 < 750ms) or is batch/asynchronous acceptable?
- Do you have authentication constraints (SAML SSO for dashboard, VPC/private deployment) for the pilot?

Proposed 30-min slots (PDT):
- Fri Jul 29, 11:00–11:30
- Mon Jul 31, 09:00–09:30
- Mon Jul 31, 14:00–14:30

If none work, paste a couple local times and we'll send a calendar invite. I'll also attach a one-page demo deck and a short pilot checklist so you know what we typically validate during the pilot.

Best,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Jul 28, 2028 at 10:05 AM Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the context and for signing up. I'm Priyom on the SDR team; looping in Ben (AE) to join the call so we can cover pricing and pilot options. A few quick clarifying questions so we come prepared:
>
> - Is the 500k–2M monthly count receipts (i.e., 1 API call per receipt) or documents bundled (e.g., batches of receipts per request)?
> - Do you need embedding vectors (search/index) in addition to the extraction APIs, or purely structured extraction + entity normalization?
> - Any latency SLOs for the extraction path (e.g., P95 < 750ms) or is batch/asynchronous acceptable?
> - Do you have authentication constraints (SAML SSO for dashboard, VPC/private deployment) for the pilot?

Thanks — happy to confirm. Answers below and slot confirmation.

Answers:
- Volume: mostly 1 API call per receipt; we do a small bundling step for merchants sending multiple receipts in a single payload but the numbers I quoted are per-receipt equivalents. Expecting ~700k monthly in an initial pilot (ramp over 8 weeks) and then scale to ~1.5M if pilot is successful.
- Embeddings: we will want embeddings for search later, but for pilot focus is structured extraction + normalization.
- Latency: near-real-time preferred. Target is P95 < 1s for individual extraction calls; small batch async is acceptable for larger merchant uploads.
- Auth/compliance: we'll need SSO for our admin users, and we prefer hosted with a possibility to evaluate Dedicated if noise issues arise. No air-gapped/on-prem requirement for the pilot.

I'll take the Mon Jul 31, 14:00–14:30 PDT slot — that works for our engineering lead. Please send the invite and include Ben & Monica. I've re-attached the sample traffic CSV in case you didn't get it earlier.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the demo.

—
Alex Turner
Director, Data Engineering, FastRetail
